verdict.rationale: Radar is an ML-driven fraud product, so a buyer could fairly ask whether their data trains its models. The axis applies, but no evidence item documents an opt-out from model training or any data-use control. The community note about opting out of per-transaction screening concerns fraud checks, not training data, and does not transfer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
